summary: Customer inquired about a sudden increase in loan interest rate.

intents.keywords: नमस्ते मैं पूजा गुप्ता मेरे लोन की ब्याज दर अचानक ... गई है।

issues.issue: Unexpected increase in loan interest rate.
issues.reason(s): RBI's new policy caused the change in interest rate.

issues.issue: Did not receive a notice about the interest rate change.

intents.actions of agent: Agent checked the account, explained the reason for the increase, offered to send details via email, and submitted a review request.
intents.resolution: Agent will send details via email and provide an update after the review.
